items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: I learned a little blind boy, he was sitting there how to play, not clarinet, I learned him how to play saxophone. And he was out in Baton Rouge, he was going to school and he was a great clarinet player. I called him Sidney.

ctx.x: He played with Louie Dumaine. He might have heard him with Louie.

He played with Amos Riley, uptown Amos Riley. And so he could take his watch out, the face was broke. So come on, we ain't got about a minute to catch this call. Come on, we got one minute. When he feel like watch the face was open, you could tell the time. I learned a little blind boy, he was sitting there how to play, not clarinet, I learned him how to play saxophone. And he was out in Baton Rouge, he was going to school and he was a great clarinet player. I called him Sidney. Good saxophone player. I know…
